exposure: mode of delivery (vaginal delivery vs. cesarean section)
head progression distance (PD) during the first stage of labor
cohort: 87 nulliparous women beyond 37 week's gestation during the first stage of labor
finding: Head progression distance (PD) during the first stage of labor was significantly longer in nulliparous women who delivered vaginally compared to those who underwent a cesarean section for obstructed labor.
mod_finding: PD measurements during the first stage of labor among nulliparous women differ significantly both in rest and during pushing between patients who delivered vaginally compared to CS and can therefore assist in predicting the mode of delivery.
